thread:
lucas.p: Postmortem action sync — distilling follow-ups for vendor/dependency outages. Observed failure modes: regional cloud control-plane blips that dropped LB updates, model-registry auth churn causing manifest fetch failures, and the external auth provider emitting spikes of 429s during large rollouts. I'm collecting owners/timelines here so we don't lose track.

kevin.h: Happy to take the LB/control-plane mitigations. Proposal: implement active-active frontends across two regions + health-probe-driven traffic steering at the edge. Also add a small synthetic workload to exercise control plane changes daily. ETA: prototype in 10 days, full rollout in 5 weeks. I'll open INFRA ticket.

emily.ops: I'll coordinate with cloud account team and request incident CSV + request formal RCA from provider. Also checking contractual SLA wording for control-plane availability. ETA: vendor ask today, update by 2026-03-23.

daisy_lee: For model-registry: short-term local cache of last-known manifests + a "serve-readonly" mode if auth API fails. Medium-term: add a client circuit-breaker + token refresh jittering to avoid thundering herds during rollouts. I'll add dashboard alerts for manifest-fetch 5xx/429 rate. ETA for cache + tests: 2026-04-08.

oncall-bot: Auto-note: Incident reference 2026-03-15-C2 linked: https://incidents.internal/2026-03-15-C2 (summary: auth provider rate spikes caused ~12m of manifest read failures)

lucas.p: Concrete action list (please copy into your trackers):
- A1 Cross-region active-active frontends + synthetic control-plane exercise \u2014 owner: kevin.h \u2014 due: 2026-04-20
- A2 Registry local-cache + readonly fallback \u2014 owner: daisy_lee \u2014 due: 2026-04-08
- A3 Registry client circuit-breaker + jittered token refresh \u2014 owner: daisy_lee \u2014 due: 2026-04-15
- A4 Vendor SLA review & formal RCA request \u2014 owner: emily.ops \u2014 due: 2026-03-23
- A5 Pre-rollout throttle & canary gating checklist for model pushes \u2014 owner: lucas.p \u2014 start: immediate, applying to next 2 rollouts

kevin.h: Minimal infra checklist I'll attach to the ticket:
```
- Deploy frontends in region-a and region-b
- Configure global LB with session affinity off
- Health probes: /_hc on ingest and registry proxies
- Synthetic update job: run every 6h to apply a no-op control-plane change and verify LB converges
- Alert: >2 failed LB updates in 15m -> P1 to #incidents
```

daisy_lee: Example circuit-breaker settings I'm starting with for the registry client:
```json
{"failure_threshold": 6, "reset_interval_s": 60, "half_open_probe_rate": 5, "on_429": "slowdown"}
```

emily.ops: A question: for readonly fallback in registry, do we need image-signing verification offline? Security wants a checksum validation step.

daisy_lee: Good call. We'll keep signature verification but use cached signatures fetched with manifests. If manifest missing, serve cached artifact only if signature present and timestamp < 7 days. I'll note this in the task.

lucas.p: Risk note: we've seen auth 429 bursts align with deployment churn. Immediate mitigation: next two rollouts we throttle to 10% per minute and enable canary routing to 1% until metrics stable. Also, add a pre-rollout ticket requirement: check auth 95p latency and 429 rate < 0.5% over last 10m.

oncall-bot: Reminder created by lucas.p: pre-rollout auth healthcheck gating (one-time) scheduled at next deploy window.

emily.ops: Vendor engagement update: opened CASE-100412 with cloud control-plane team and CASE-100413 with auth provider. Asked for 90-day 429/latency time series.

kevin.h: Creating INFRA-8799 for active-active blueprint and synthetic job. Will link here when PR is up.

daisy_lee: Created MLENG-3378 (registry cache) and MLENG-3379 (circuit-breaker + metrics). Links: https://tracker.internal/MLENG-3378, https://tracker.internal/MLENG-3379

lucas.p: Great. I'll run a short biweekly vendor-pattern review starting 2026-03-29 to track recurrences and shift priorities. Owner: lucas.p, cadence: biweekly.

emily.ops: I'll push for contractual addendum if vendors can't show mitigation for repeated control-plane blips. Also asking for credits for incident window.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: vendor-pattern-review biweekly starting 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC.

lucas.p: Closing ask: please paste ticket/PR links here when you create them, and call out any blockers. I'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-up doc and update Product/Execs next week. Thanks all. :handshake:
